desc: Implement row-wise lazy DP with cursor invariants, transposition, initial full forward/backward DP, per-query partial row recomputation, and delta answer maintenance.
Handle edge cases: start/end cells, zero values, modulo arithmetic, transposed direction remapping, and cursor boundary guarantees.
Validate against samples and random small brute-force tests.
Optimize hot paths for Python: flat arrays, local bindings, minimal modulo operations, skip unchanged values, and consider periodic full rebuild if needed.
If performance is insufficient, evaluate fallback approaches (time-block decomposition or dirty propagation) rather than polishing the same implementation.
